children: Axos Financial reported first-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue of $395.1 million, up 22.2% from the prior-year quarter, and net income of $129.6 million, up 15.4%. Diluted EPS rose 16% to $2.25, while net interest margin declined 11 basis points to 4.64%.
Revenue was $395.1M, compared with $323.4M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 22.2%.
Net income was $129.6M, compared with $112.4M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 15.4%.
Diluted EPS was $2.25, compared with $1.94 in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 16.0%.
Net interest margin was 4.64%, down 11 basis points year over year.
Net interest income increased 13.8% to $331.3M. Non-interest income nearly doubled, driven by banking and service fees tied to Verdant leasing activity and higher prepayment fees.
Verdant expanded the company’s equipment leasing business, while Jenius Bank and Capital One IRA deposits broadened the deposit base.
Technology investment increased data and operational processing costs. Arc Technologies added cash-management and AI capabilities.
Commercial real estate loans grew. Higher charge-offs were concentrated in two commercial and industrial borrowers.
